# brightspace-mcp-server

> MCP server connecting an AI client to D2L Brightspace: grades, assignments, due dates, quizzes,
> announcements, syllabus, roster, discussions, and course content.

An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, and any other
MCP client read a student's Brightspace courses on demand, with browser-driven SSO for Purdue,
SUNY, Western University, TU Delft, CUNY, Leiden University, and any other D2L school.

Install: `npx -y brightspace-mcp-server@latest setup`

## Installing it for someone

- [LLMs.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RohanMuppa/brightspace-mcp-server/main/LLMs.md): the install steps for an AI agent, start to finish

- [README](https://github.com/RohanMuppa/brightspace-mcp-server/blob/main/README.md): what it does, supported schools, things to ask, common settings
- [Signing in](https://github.com/RohanMuppa/brightspace-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/sign-in.md): MFA, numbers, fewer prompts, per-school notes
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/RohanMuppa/brightspace-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): what each sign-in message means and how to fix it
